about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer with experience in building modern web applications. I love creating elegant solutions to complex problems.
about.paragraph2: With a strong foundation in both frontend and backend technologies, I specialize in creating seamless user experiences and robust server-side applications.
about.paragraph3: When I'm not coding, you can find me reading technical books, contributing to open source, or exploring new technologies.
